question: The 'Montreal Protocol' was signed to control the emission of _____.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**chlorofluorocarbons**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Montreal Protocol** was adopted in **1987** and is an international treaty designed to protect the **ozone layer**.
 
• Its primary goal is to phase out the production and consumption of **ozone-depleting substances (ODS)**, particularly **chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)**.
 
• **Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)** are compounds containing **carbon, chlorine, and fluorine**, and they are commonly used in refrigeration, air conditioning, and aerosol sprays.
 
• CFCs release **chlorine atoms** into the atmosphere, which react with ozone molecules, leading to the **depletion of the ozone layer**.
 
• The depletion of the ozone layer causes harmful **ultraviolet (UV) radiation** to reach the Earth's surface, leading to various health and environmental issues such as **skin cancer**, cataracts, and damage to ecosystems.
 
• The **Montreal Protocol** is considered one of the most successful international environmental agreements, as it has significantly reduced the use of CFCs globally.
 
• The treaty has been ratified by almost all countries and has led to the recovery of the ozone layer, which is expected to return to its pre-1980 levels by the middle of the **21st century**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Carbon dioxide**__

 __
 
• **Carbon dioxide (CO₂)** is a greenhouse gas that contributes to **global warming** and climate change.
 
• It is primarily emitted through the burning of **fossil fuels**, deforestation, and industrial processes.
 
• Although CO₂ is not directly responsible for ozone depletion, its increasing concentration in the atmosphere is linked to adverse climate effects.
 
 
 
• **Methane**__
 __
 
• **Methane (CH₄)** is another potent greenhouse gas that contributes to **global warming**.
 
• It is released through activities such as **agriculture** (e.g., livestock farming), the decay of organic matter, and the extraction of **natural gas**.
 
• While methane does not deplete the ozone layer, it has a significant impact on climate change.
 
 
 
• **Sulphur dioxide**__
 
 
• **Sulphur dioxide (SO₂)** is primarily produced through the burning of **coal and oil**, as well as volcanic eruptions.
 
• SO₂ contributes to the formation of **acid rain**, which can damage ecosystems, buildings, and human health.
 
• Unlike CFCs, SO₂ does not play a direct role in ozone depletion but has environmental impacts in other ways.
